  SELECT MIT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFICE_PHONE FROM students_with_dept
  UNION
  SELECT MIT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME, OFFICE_PHONE FROM students_with_dept_drupal
)
SELECT
  sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  sd.OFFICE_PHONE AS OFFICE_PHONE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sd.MIT_ID) AS SUBSCRIBER_COUNT
FROM students_dept_union sd
WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.OFFICE_PHONE
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sd.MIT_ID) = (
  SELECT MAX(dept_count) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sd2.MIT_ID) AS dept_count
    FROM students_dept_union sd2
    WHERE sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd2.OFFICE_PHONE
  ) x
)
ORDER BY SUBSCRIBER_COUNT DESC

rows.question: For each mailing group, list its owner, owner type, the member visibility ('Public Members' if public, and 'Hidden Members' otherwise), and the number of members of this type of visibility. For each owner and owner type, include a grand total for all members in the format of (owner, owner type, null, total members).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH owner_group_members AS (
  -- For each list, bring together its owner, owner_type, is_public, and member ids
  SELECT
    ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY AS MAILING_GROUP_ID,
    mlo.OWNER AS OWNER,
    mlo.OWNER_TYPE AS OWNER_TYPE,
    ml.IS_PUBLIC AS IS_PUBLIC,
    d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID AS MEMBER_MIT_ID
  FROM moira_list ml
  LEFT JOIN moira_list_owner mlo
    ON ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
  LEFT JOIN moira_list_detail d
    ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
owner_visibility_counts AS (
  -- Count distinct members per (OWNER, OWNER_TYPE, IS_PUBLIC)
  SELECT
    OWNER,
    OWNER_TYPE,
    IS_PUBLIC,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS MEMBER_COUNT
  FROM owner_group_members
  GROUP BY OWNER, OWNER_TYPE, IS_PUBLIC
)
-- visibility-specific rows
SELECT
  OWNER AS OWNER,
  OWNER_TYPE AS OWNER_TYPE,
  CASE WHEN IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' THEN 'Public Members' ELSE 'Hidden Members' END AS MEMBER_VISIBILITY,
  MEMBER_COUNT AS MEMBER_COUNT
FROM owner_visibility_counts

UNION ALL

-- grand-total rows per (OWNER, OWNER_TYPE)
SELECT
  OWNER AS OWNER,
  OWNER_TYPE AS OWNER_TYPE,
  NULL AS MEMBER_VISIBILITY,
  SUM(MEMBER_COUNT) AS MEMBER_COUNT
FROM owner_visibility_counts
GROUP BY OWNER, OWNER_TYPE

ORDER BY
  -- OWNER ascending, NULLs last
  (OWNER IS NULL), OWNER,
  -- OWNER_TYPE ascending, NULLs last
  (OWNER_TYPE IS NULL), OWNER_TYPE,
  -- visibility order: Public, Hidden, then NULL (total)
  CASE
    WHEN MEMBER_VISIBILITY = 'Public Members' THEN 1
    WHEN MEMBER_VISIBILITY = 'Hidden Members' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END

rows.question: Group biology courses by cluster type and course level. For each group, list the name of the department, the course title, cluster type, total enrollments, average enrollment within its cluster, course level, number of unique course materials, average new and used prices for TIP materials, total material record count for TIP materials, number of unique library titles, and number of unique library ISBNs.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH academic_term_dates AS (
SELECT
  `TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  `TERM_START_DATE` AS TERM_START_DATE,
  `TERM_END_DATE` AS TERM_END_DATE,
  `ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY` AS ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY
FROM `academic_terms`
),
academic_terms_reference AS (
SELECT
  `ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY`,
  `TERM_CODE`,
  `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
  `TERM_START_DATE`,
  `TERM_END_DATE`,
  `IS_CURRENT_TERM`
FROM `academic_terms`
)
SELECT
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS course_title,
  so.CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  course_tot.total_enrollments AS total_enrollments,
  cluster_avg.avg_enrollment_within_cluster AS avg_enrollment_within_cluster,
  so.COURSE_NUMBER AS course_level,
  IFNULL(tip_agg.unique_course_materials,0) AS unique_course_materials,
  tip_agg.avg_new_price_tip AS avg_new_price_tip,
  tip_agg.avg_used_price_tip AS avg_used_price_tip,
  IFNULL(tip_agg.total_tip_material_records,0) AS total_tip_material_records,
  IFNULL(lib_agg.unique_library_titles,0) AS unique_library_titles,
  IFNULL(lib_agg.unique_library_isbns,0) AS unique_library_isbns
FROM
  -- primary course rows for Biology
  subject_offered so
  -- aggregate enrollments to course (subject+course_number+cluster_type+term) level
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      TERM_CODE,
      SUBJECT_ID,
      COURSE_NUMBER,
      CLUSTER_TYPE,
      SUM(IFNULL(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0)) AS total_enrollments
    FROM subject_offered
    WHERE OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'
    GROUP BY TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_NUMBER, CLUSTER_TYPE
  ) AS course_tot
    ON course_tot.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
   AND course_tot.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
   AND course_tot.COURSE_NUMBER = so.COURSE_NUMBER
   AND ((course_tot.CLUSTER_TYPE = so.CLUSTER_TYPE) OR (course_tot.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NULL AND so.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NULL))
  -- compute average enrollment within the same cluster_type and course level (across courses in that cluster & level for the same term)
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      TERM_CODE,
      CLUSTER_TYPE,
      COURSE_NUMBER,
      AVG(total_enrollments) AS avg_enrollment_within_cluster
    FROM (
      SELECT
        TERM_CODE,
        SUBJECT_ID,
        COURSE_NUMBER,
        CLUSTER_TYPE,
        SUM(IFNULL(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0)) AS total_enrollments
      FROM subject_offered
      WHERE OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'
      GROUP BY TERM_CODE, SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_NUMBER, CLUSTER_TYPE
    ) t
    GROUP BY TERM_CODE, CLUSTER_TYPE, COURSE_NUMBER
  ) AS cluster_avg
    ON cluster_avg.TERM_CODE = course_tot.TERM_CODE
   AND ((cluster_avg.CLUSTER_TYPE = course_tot.CLUSTER_TYPE) OR (cluster_avg.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NULL AND course_tot.CLUSTER_TYPE IS NULL))
   AND cluster_avg.COURSE_NUMBER = course_tot.COURSE_NUMBER
  -- aggregate TIP materials per course (subject+term)
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      td.TERM_CODE,
      td.SUBJECT_ID,
      COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_course_materials,
      AVG(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_price_tip,
      AVG(tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_used_price_tip,
      SUM(IFNULL(td.RECORD_COUNT,0)) AS total_tip_material_records
    FROM tip_detail td
    LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
      ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
    GROUP BY td.TERM_CODE, td.SUBJECT_ID
  ) AS tip_agg
    ON tip_agg.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
   AND tip_agg.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
  -- aggregate library reserve titles/isbns per course (subject+term)
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      lmd.TERM_CODE,
      lmd.SUBJECT_ID,
      COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_TITLE) AS unique_library_titles,
      COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.CATALOG_ISBN) AS unique_library_isbns
    FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lmd
    LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
      ON lmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    GROUP BY lmd.TERM_CODE, lmd.SUBJECT_ID
  ) AS lib_agg
    ON lib_agg.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE
   AND lib_agg.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Biology'
GROUP BY
  so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  so.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  course_tot.total_enrollments,
  cluster_avg.avg_enrollment_within_cluster,
  so.COURSE_NUMBER,
  tip_agg.unique_course_materials,
  tip_agg.avg_new_price_tip,
  tip_agg.avg_used_price_tip,
  tip_agg.total_tip_material_records,
  lib_agg.unique_library_titles,
  lib_agg.unique_library_isbns
ORDER BY
  so.CLUSTER_TYPE,
  so.COURSE_NUMBER,
  so.SUBJECT_ID

rows.question: For subjects offered this year in either the Fall or Spring term, list its department name, school name, subject ID, subject title, course level, total units, the term it is offered ('Spring' for Spring term and 'Fall' for Fall term), term description, the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Fall, and the number of distinct instructors teaching in the Spring.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_subject_year_offering_flags AS (
  SELECT
    'cis_course_catalog' AS source_table,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    c.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    c.TOTAL_UNITS,
    c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR,
    c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
    c.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM,
    c.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
    c.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS EFFECTIVE_SCHOOL_NAME,
    NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM cis_course_catalog c

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'course_catalog_subject_offered' AS source_table,
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    s.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    s.TOTAL_UNITS,
    s.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR,
    s.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
    s.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM,
    s.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
    s.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    s.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS EFFECTIVE_SCHOOL_NAME,
    NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered s

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'drupal_course_catalog' AS source_table,
    d.SUBJECT_ID,
    d.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    d.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    d.TOTAL_UNITS,
    d.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR,
    d.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM,
    d.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM,
    d.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,
    d.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    d.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
    NULL AS EFFECTIVE_SCHOOL_NAME,
    NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    NULL AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM drupal_course_catalog d
),
split_numbers AS (
  SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
  UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
subject_instructor_expanded AS (
  SELECT
    cs.source_table,
    cs.SUBJECT_ID,
    'Fall' AS term_label,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(IFNULL(cs.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,''), ',', sn.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM course_subject_year_offering_flags cs
  JOIN split_numbers sn
    ON sn.n <= GREATEST(1, 1 + (LENGTH(IFNULL(cs.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,'')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(IFNULL(cs.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,''), ',', ''))))
  WHERE IFNULL(cs.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,'') <> ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    cs.source_table,
    cs.SUBJECT_ID,
    'Spring' AS term_label,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(IFNULL(cs.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,''), ',', sn.n), ',', -1)) AS instructor
  FROM course_subject_year_offering_flags cs
  JOIN split_numbers sn
    ON sn.n <= GREATEST(1, 1 + (LENGTH(IFNULL(cs.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,'')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(IFNULL(cs.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,''), ',', ''))))
  WHERE IFNULL(cs.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,'') <> ''
),
subject_instructor_counts_agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    term_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(instructor, '')) AS distinct_instructors_total
  FROM subject_instructor_expanded
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, term_label
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS department_name,
  COALESCE(cs.EFFECTIVE_SCHOOL_NAME, cs.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_name,
  cs.SUBJECT_ID,
  cs.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  CASE
    WHEN cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT(REGEXP_SUBSTR(cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, '^[0-9]+'), '-level')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS course_level,
  cs.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units,
  t.term_offered AS term_offered,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COALESCE(fall_cnt.distinct_instructors_total, 0) AS distinct_instructors_fall,
  COALESCE(spr_cnt.distinct_instructors_total, 0) AS distinct_instructors_spring
FROM course_subject_year_offering_flags cs
JOIN (
  SELECT 'Fall' AS term_offered UNION ALL SELECT 'Spring'
) t ON ( (t.term_offered = 'Fall' AND cs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y')
       OR (t.term_offered = 'Spring' AND cs.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y') )
LEFT JOIN academic_terms at
  ON at.TERM_CODE = cs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_instructor_counts_agg fall_cnt
  ON fall_cnt.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID AND fall_cnt.term_label = 'Fall'
LEFT JOIN subject_instructor_counts_agg spr_cnt
  ON spr_cnt.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID AND spr_cnt.term_label = 'Spring'
WHERE
  cs.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
  AND (cs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' OR cs.IS_OFFERED_SPRING_TERM = 'Y')
ORDER BY
  department_name,
  cs.SUBJECT_ID,
  t.term_offered

rows.question: For Political Science courses with HASS attributes, for each attribute, list the name and description of the attribute, the number of unique subjects, average units, the total enrollment, the number of departments that grant degrees, and the subject code description.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_rows AS (
  SELECT
    ccs.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    ccs.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION AS SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ccs.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    ccs.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
    NULLIF(TRIM(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS), '') AS TOTAL_UNITS_RAW
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    d.SUBJECT_CODE,
    d.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    d.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    d.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    d.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
    NULLIF(TRIM(d.TOTAL_UNITS), '')
  FROM drupal_course_catalog d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    cis.SUBJECT_CODE,
    cis.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    cis.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cis.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cis.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    cis.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
    NULLIF(TRIM(cis.TOTAL_UNITS), '')
  FROM cis_course_catalog cis
),
-- parse TOTAL_UNITS into numeric where possible
course_rows_parsed AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
    CASE
      WHEN TOTAL_UNITS_RAW REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(TOTAL_UNITS_RAW AS DECIMAL(10,2))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS TOTAL_UNITS_NUM
  FROM course_rows
  WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
    AND HASS_ATTRIBUTE IS NOT NULL
    AND HASS_ATTRIBUTE <> ''
),
-- Get total enrollment per subject code from subject_summary if available
subject_enrollment AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUM(COALESCE(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER,0)) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_SUM
  FROM subject_summary
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID
)
SELECT
  crp.HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  crp.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC,
  COUNT(DISTINCT crp.SUBJECT_CODE) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
  -- average TOTAL_UNITS across distinct SUBJECT_CODE: compute per subject_code first to avoid weighting by multiple rows
  AVG(subj_units.avg_total_units) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  COALESCE(SUM(se.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_SUM),0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLMENT,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN crp.DEPARTMENT_CODE END) AS NUM_DEGREE_GRANTING_DEPARTMENTS,
  -- provide mapping of subject_code -> representative description; concatenated list
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(crp.SUBJECT_CODE, ': ', COALESCE(crp.SUBJECT_TITLE, crp.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, '')) 
               ORDER BY crp.SUBJECT_CODE SEPARATOR ' | ') AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESCRIPTION
FROM course_rows_parsed crp
LEFT JOIN sis_department sd
  ON crp.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN subject_enrollment se
  ON se.SUBJECT_CODE = crp.SUBJECT_CODE
-- compute per-attribute, but to get average across distinct subjects we need per-subject aggregation
LEFT JOIN (
  -- per subject_code, take average TOTAL_UNITS_NUM across rows for that subject (NULLs excluded)
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS_NUM) AS avg_total_units
  FROM course_rows_parsed
  GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE
) subj_units
  ON subj_units.SUBJECT_CODE = crp.SUBJECT_CODE
GROUP BY
  crp.HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
  crp.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC
ORDER BY NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS DESC

rows.question: Group subjects by cluster type, department offering the subject, and the school name. For each group, list the cluster type, name of the department, school name, whether the department grants degrees, total number of subjects, total enrollment, and average enrollment. Exclude clusters or schools with no student data.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH academic_terms_lookup AS (
SELECT
  `TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
  `TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  `TERM_START_DATE` AS TERM_START_DATE,
  `TERM_END_DATE` AS TERM_END_DATE,
  `ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  `IS_CURRENT_TERM` AS IS_CURRENT_TERM
FROM
  `academic_terms`
),
drupal_subject_section_core AS (
SELECT
  d.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE AS SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
  d.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
  d.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  d.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  d.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,
  d.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  d.SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION AS SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  d.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES AS SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES
FROM drupal_course_catalog d
)
SELECT
  drupal_subject_section_core.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE AS cluster_type,
  drupal_subject_section_core.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
  drupal_subject_section_core.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES AS school_name,
  sis_department.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING AS department_grants_degrees,
  COUNT(DISTINCT drupal_subject_section_core.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(subject_offered_summary.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment,
  AVG(subject_offered_summary.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS average_enrollment
FROM drupal_subject_section_core
JOIN subject_offered_summary
  ON drupal_subject_section_core.SUBJECT_ID = subject_offered_summary.SUBJECT_ID
  AND drupal_subject_section_core.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = subject_offered_summary.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN sis_department
  ON drupal_subject_section_core.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sis_department.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WHERE subject_offered_summary.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  drupal_subject_section_core.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
  drupal_subject_section_core.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  drupal_subject_section_core.SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES,
  sis_department.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
HAVING SUM(subject_offered_summary.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 0
ORDER BY cluster_type, department_name, school_name

rows.question: For each course, provide the room number of course location, building name, building number, building city, building state, area, organization name, room usage, term code, course level, the total number of subjects, unique meeting times, and total units. Do not include meet place or meet times with NULL values.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_core AS (
SELECT
  `BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
  `BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
  `BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  CAST(`BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` AS SIGNED) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  CAST(`BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` AS SIGNED) AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM `buildings`
)
SELECT
  TRIM(SUBSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,
        INSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE, ' ')+1)) AS room_number,
  bc.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  TRIM(SUBSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,1,CASE WHEN INSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,' ')>0 THEN INSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,' ')-1 ELSE LENGTH(sp.MEET_PLACE) END)) AS building_number,
  NULL AS building_city,
  NULL AS building_state,
  COALESCE(bc.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, bc.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS area,
  COALESCE(sp.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sp.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME) AS organization_name,
  NULL AS room_usage,
  sp.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  CASE
    WHEN sp.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(sp.SUBJECT_NUMBER,'^[0-9]+')
    ELSE NULL
  END AS course_level,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sp.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sp.MEET_TIME) AS unique_meeting_times,
  sp.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(course_catalog_subject_offered.TERM_CODE, course_catalog_subject_offered.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, drupal_course_catalog.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, drupal_course_catalog.SO_TERM_CODE, cis_course_catalog.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    COALESCE(course_catalog_subject_offered.SECTION_ID, drupal_course_catalog.SECTION_ID, course_catalog_subject_offered.SECTION_ID) AS SECTION_ID,
    COALESCE(course_catalog_subject_offered.MEET_PLACE, drupal_course_catalog.MEET_PLACE, course_catalog_subject_offered.MEET_PLACE) AS MEET_PLACE,
    COALESCE(course_catalog_subject_offered.MEET_TIME, drupal_course_catalog.MEET_TIME, course_catalog_subject_offered.MEET_TIME) AS MEET_TIME,
    COALESCE(course_catalog_subject_offered.SUBJECT_ID, drupal_course_catalog.SUBJECT_ID, cis_course_catalog.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(course_catalog_subject_offered.SUBJECT_NUMBER, drupal_course_catalog.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cis_course_catalog.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(course_catalog_subject_offered.TOTAL_UNITS, drupal_course_catalog.TOTAL_UNITS, cis_course_catalog.TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    COALESCE(course_catalog_subject_offered.DEPARTMENT_NAME, drupal_course_catalog.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis_course_catalog.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COALESCE(course_catalog_subject_offered.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, drupal_course_catalog.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL) AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog ON FALSE
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog ON FALSE
) AS sp
LEFT JOIN building_core bc
  ON bc.BUILDING_NUMBER = TRIM(SUBSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,1,CASE WHEN INSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,' ')>0 THEN INSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,' ')-1 ELSE LENGTH(sp.MEET_PLACE) END))
WHERE sp.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
  AND sp.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  TRIM(SUBSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,
        INSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE, ' ')+1)),
  bc.BUILDING_NAME,
  TRIM(SUBSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,1,CASE WHEN INSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,' ')>0 THEN INSTR(sp.MEET_PLACE,' ')-1 ELSE LENGTH(sp.MEET_PLACE) END)),
  COALESCE(bc.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, bc.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE),
  COALESCE(sp.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sp.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME),
  sp.TERM_CODE,
  CASE
    WHEN sp.SUBJECT_NUMBER REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(sp.SUBJECT_NUMBER,'^[0-9]+')
    ELSE NULL
  END,
  sp.TOTAL_UNITS

rows.question: Consider only books cataloged on or after 2000. For each library material status and department, list the material status, department name, number of associated catalog items, and the total number of enrolled students in courses using those materials. Include subtotals for each material status and a grand total across all status (the corresponding status field is 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- map sections to department and master_subject from the course offering feed
section_dept AS (
  SELECT
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    SECTION_ID,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL OR SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
),
-- base detail: per material status + department (only include rows where both status and department are non-null for detail rows)
detail AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    COALESCE(SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS),0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
    ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  LEFT JOIN section_dept sd
    -- lrmd.SUBJECT_ID in this schema appears to be the subject/master_subject reference;
    -- try to match by MASTER_SUBJECT_ID OR by SECTION_ID if available
    ON sd.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
    OR sd.SECTION_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
    ON so.SECTION_ID = sd.SECTION_ID
  WHERE
    (
      (lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE >= '2000-01-01')
      OR (lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE >= '2000-01-01')
    )
    AND lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS IS NOT NULL
    AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown'), sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
-- subtotals per material status (include all departments, even if department is null, per requirements)
status_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    MATERIAL_STATUS,
    'Subtotal' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    SUM(TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM (
    -- derive per-status, per-department (including dept NULL) so subtotal sums match detail source
    SELECT
      COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
      sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
      COALESCE(SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS),0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
    JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
      ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
      ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
    LEFT JOIN section_dept sd
      ON sd.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
      OR sd.SECTION_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
    LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
      ON so.SECTION_ID = sd.SECTION_ID
    WHERE
      (
        (lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE >= '2000-01-01')
        OR (lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE >= '2000-01-01')
      )
    GROUP BY COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown'), sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  ) s
  GROUP BY MATERIAL_STATUS
),
-- grand total across all statuses
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    'All Departments' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUM(CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
    SUM(TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown') AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
      sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      COUNT(DISTINCT lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
      COALESCE(SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS),0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
    FROM library_reserve_catalog lrc
    JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
      ON lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY = lrc.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
      ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
    LEFT JOIN section_dept sd
      ON sd.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
      OR sd.SECTION_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
    LEFT JOIN subject_offered so
      ON so.SECTION_ID = sd.SECTION_ID
    WHERE
      (
        (lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_CREATE_DATE >= '2000-01-01')
        OR (lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND lrc.CATALOG_RECORD_UPDATE_DATE >= '2000-01-01')
      )
    GROUP BY COALESCE(lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, 'Unknown'), sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  ) g
)
-- combine detail rows, subtotals, and grand total; add ordering keys so subtotals appear after departments
SELECT
  d.MATERIAL_STATUS,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
  d.TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM detail d

UNION ALL

SELECT
  s.MATERIAL_STATUS,
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  s.CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
  s.TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM status_subtotals s

UNION ALL

SELECT
  g.MATERIAL_STATUS,
  g.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  g.CATALOG_ITEM_COUNT,
  g.TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM grand_total g

ORDER BY
  -- ensure groups by status, with department rows first, then the 'Subtotal' row, and grand total last
  CASE WHEN MATERIAL_STATUS = 'Grand Total' THEN 3 ELSE 1 END,
  MATERIAL_STATUS,
  CASE WHEN DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Subtotal' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME

rows.question: For each course with enrolled students and with books in the library system, list the name of the department of that course, total number of courses using library materials, the number of catalog items associated with those courses, and the average enrollment per course. Include a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field should be 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
-- enrollment per subject (use library_subject_offered.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS when present;
-- fallback to 0 if missing; group by SUBJECT_ID)
enrollment_per_subject AS (
  SELECT
    lso.SUBJECT_ID,
    SUM(COALESCE(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS enrollment_total
  FROM library_subject_offered AS lso
  WHERE lso.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- catalog items per subject from reserve material detail
catalog_items_per_subject AS (
  SELECT
    lrmd.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_items_per_course
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail AS lrmd
  WHERE lrmd.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
),
-- subject to department mapping (one row per SUBJECT_ID with department name)
subject_department AS (
  SELECT
    cso.SUBJECT_ID,
    cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS cso
  WHERE cso.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cso.SUBJECT_ID, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
-- subjects that satisfy both: have >0 enrollment and >=1 catalog item
eligible_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    sd.SUBJECT_ID,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    eps.enrollment_total,
    COALESCE(cips.catalog_items_per_course, 0) AS catalog_items_per_course
  FROM subject_department sd
  JOIN enrollment_per_subject eps ON eps.SUBJECT_ID = sd.SUBJECT_ID
  JOIN catalog_items_per_subject cips ON cips.SUBJECT_ID = sd.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE eps.enrollment_total > 0
)
-- per-department aggregation plus grand total row
SELECT
  department_name AS department_name,
  courses_using_library_materials,
  catalog_items_count,
  average_enrollment_per_course
FROM (
  -- per-department rows
  SELECT
    es.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT es.SUBJECT_ID) AS courses_using_library_materials,
    SUM(es.catalog_items_per_course) AS catalog_items_count,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT es.SUBJECT_ID) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE SUM(es.enrollment_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT es.SUBJECT_ID)
    END AS average_enrollment_per_course,
    0 AS sortord
  FROM eligible_subjects es
  GROUP BY es.DEPARTMENT_NAME

  UNION ALL

  -- grand total row
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS department_name,
    SUM(dept.courses_using_library_materials) AS courses_using_library_materials,
    SUM(dept.catalog_items_count) AS catalog_items_count,
    CASE WHEN SUM(dept.courses_using_library_materials) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE SUM(dept.average_enrollment_per_course * dept.courses_using_library_materials)
              / SUM(dept.courses_using_library_materials)
    END AS average_enrollment_per_course,
    1 AS sortord
  FROM (
    SELECT
      es.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
      COUNT(DISTINCT es.SUBJECT_ID) AS courses_using_library_materials,
      SUM(es.catalog_items_per_course) AS catalog_items_count,
      CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT es.SUBJECT_ID) = 0 THEN NULL
           ELSE SUM(es.enrollment_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT es.SUBJECT_ID)
      END AS average_enrollment_per_course
    FROM eligible_subjects es
    GROUP BY es.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  ) AS dept
) AS final
ORDER BY sortord ASC, department_name ASC

rows.question: For each department and school offering courses with materials, list the department name, school name, number of unique course materials, number of courses, average new and used shelf prices of materials, total material records, and number of distinct material statuses. Include a grand total across all schools and departments (the corresponding school and department fields should be null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH course_materials AS (
  SELECT
    td.TERM_CODE,
    td.SUBJECT_ID,
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_ID,
    tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    tm.USED_SHELF_PRICE,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  FROM tip_detail td
  JOIN tip_subject_offered tso
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
   AND td.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE
   AND td.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  WHERE tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'
),
dept_school_agg AS (
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_ID,
    SCHOOL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS NUM_UNIQUE_MATERIALS,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, '::', TERM_CODE, '::', SUBJECT_ID)) AS NUM_COURSES,
    -- averages should exclude NULLs; keep as numeric for rounding later
    AVG(NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    AVG(USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
    COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_MATERIAL_RECORDS,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS NUM_DISTINCT_MATERIAL_STATUSES
  FROM course_materials
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_ID, SCHOOL_NAME
),
grand AS (
  -- For grand totals: distinct counts must be computed across all rows meeting the filter,
  -- so compute from course_materials rather than summing per-group distincts.
  SELECT
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_ID,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS NUM_UNIQUE_MATERIALS,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, '::', TERM_CODE, '::', SUBJECT_ID)) AS NUM_COURSES,
    AVG(NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
    AVG(USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
    COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_MATERIAL_RECORDS,
    COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS NUM_DISTINCT_MATERIAL_STATUSES
  FROM course_materials
)
SELECT
  DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  NUM_UNIQUE_MATERIALS,
  NUM_COURSES,
  -- Round averages to 2 decimals; preserve NULL when no non-null prices exist
  CASE WHEN AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,2) END AS AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE,
  CASE WHEN AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE,2) END AS AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE,
  TOTAL_MATERIAL_RECORDS,
  NUM_DISTINCT_MATERIAL_STATUSES
FROM (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NUM_UNIQUE_MATERIALS, NUM_COURSES, AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE, AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE, TOTAL_MATERIAL_RECORDS, NUM_DISTINCT_MATERIAL_STATUSES
  FROM dept_school_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NUM_UNIQUE_MATERIALS, NUM_COURSES, AVG_NEW_SHELF_PRICE, AVG_USED_SHELF_PRICE, TOTAL_MATERIAL_RECORDS, NUM_DISTINCT_MATERIAL_STATUSES
  FROM grand
) t
ORDER BY
  -- ensure grand total (NULLs) comes last
  CASE WHEN SCHOOL_NAME IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  SCHOOL_NAME ASC,
  DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC

rows.question: For each TIP material status, list the total number of unique materials associated with the status, the total number of records associated with the status, and the total student enrollment associated with the status. Any material status with null values should be displayed as 'No material status'. Additionally, include a grand total across all material status (the material status for this row should be displayed as 'Grand Total').
rows.pred_sql:
WITH material_status_enrollment_rollup AS (
  SELECT
    ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS MATERIAL_STATUS,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS distinct_material_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(td.RECORD_COUNT, 0)) AS record_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS student_enrollment_sum
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered AS cso
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog AS cis
    ON cis.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = cso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
    AND cis.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog AS dc
    ON dc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = cso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
    AND dc.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered AS tso
    ON tso.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE
    AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID
  LEFT JOIN tip_detail AS td
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  LEFT JOIN tip_material_status AS ms
    ON ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  GROUP BY
    ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(MATERIAL_STATUS, 'No material status') AS MATERIAL_STATUS_DISPLAY,
  CAST(distinct_material_count AS SIGNED) AS UNIQUE_MATERIAL_COUNT,
  CAST(record_count AS SIGNED) AS RECORD_COUNT,
  student_enrollment_sum AS TOTAL_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT
FROM material_status_enrollment_rollup

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Grand Total' AS MATERIAL_STATUS_DISPLAY,
  CAST(SUM(distinct_material_count) AS SIGNED) AS UNIQUE_MATERIAL_COUNT,
  CAST(SUM(record_count) AS SIGNED) AS RECORD_COUNT,
  SUM(student_enrollment_sum) AS TOTAL_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT
FROM material_status_enrollment_rollup

ORDER BY
  (MATERIAL_STATUS_DISPLAY = 'Grand Total') ASC,
  TOTAL_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT DESC

rows.question: For each room, list its associated building name, floor number, room number, ownership type, organization name, number of rooms, area, and percentage of area relative to the building. Include subtotals across floors, subtotals across all floors for each building, and a grand total across all buildings. For the subtotal for each building and the grand total, the percentage of area should be relative to area of all buildings. All numeric values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators except the relative percentages which should be rounded to two decimal places.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH rooms AS (
  -- Use fac_rooms as the canonical room-level table per schema
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    fr.FLOOR,
    fr.ROOM,
    fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    fr.AREA
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  JOIN buildings b ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE fr.AREA IS NOT NULL AND fr.AREA > 0
),
building_totals AS (
  -- total area and room count per building (only from qualifying rooms)
  SELECT
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    r.BUILDING_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS building_num_rooms,
    SUM(r.AREA) AS building_total_area
  FROM rooms r
  GROUP BY r.BUILDING_KEY, r.BUILDING_NAME
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(building_total_area) AS grand_total_area,
    SUM(building_num_rooms) AS grand_num_rooms
  FROM building_totals
),
detail_rows AS (
  SELECT
    'Detail' AS RowType,
    r.BUILDING_NAME AS BuildingName,
    r.FLOOR AS FloorNumber,
    r.ROOM AS RoomNumber,
    r.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS OwnershipType,
    r.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS OrganizationName,
    1 AS NumRooms,
    ROUND(r.AREA) AS Area,
    -- percentage relative to the building's total area
    CASE WHEN bt.building_total_area = 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.AREA / bt.building_total_area * 100 END AS PctOfBuildArea,
    r.BUILDING_KEY,
    CAST(r.FLOOR AS CHAR) AS _sort_floor,
    CAST(r.ROOM AS CHAR) AS _sort_room,
    1 AS sort_order
  FROM rooms r
  JOIN building_totals bt ON r.BUILDING_KEY = bt.BUILDING_KEY
),
floor_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    'Floor Subtotal' AS RowType,
    bt.BUILDING_NAME AS BuildingName,
    r.FLOOR AS FloorNumber,
    NULL AS RoomNumber,
    NULL AS OwnershipType,
    NULL AS OrganizationName,
    COUNT(*) AS NumRooms,
    ROUND(SUM(r.AREA)) AS Area,
    -- percent relative to the building's total area
    CASE WHEN bt.building_total_area = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(r.AREA) / bt.building_total_area * 100 END AS PctOfBuildArea,
    bt.BUILDING_KEY,
    CAST(r.FLOOR AS CHAR) AS _sort_floor,
    NULL AS _sort_room,
    2 AS sort_order
  FROM rooms r
  JOIN building_totals bt ON r.BUILDING_KEY = bt.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY bt.BUILDING_KEY, bt.BUILDING_NAME, r.FLOOR, bt.building_total_area
),
building_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    'Building Subtotal' AS RowType,
    bt.BUILDING_NAME AS BuildingName,
    'ALL FLOORS' AS FloorNumber,
    NULL AS RoomNumber,
    NULL AS OwnershipType,
    NULL AS OrganizationName,
    bt.building_num_rooms AS NumRooms,
    ROUND(bt.building_total_area) AS Area,
    -- percentage relative to grand total area across all buildings
    CASE WHEN gt.grand_total_area = 0 THEN 0 ELSE bt.building_total_area / gt.grand_total_area * 100 END AS PctOfBuildArea,
    bt.BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL AS _sort_floor,
    NULL AS _sort_room,
    3 AS sort_order
  FROM building_totals bt
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
),
grand_total_row AS (
  SELECT
    'Grand Total' AS RowType,
    'GRAND TOTAL' AS BuildingName,
    NULL AS FloorNumber,
    NULL AS RoomNumber,
    NULL AS OwnershipType,
    NULL AS OrganizationName,
    gt.grand_num_rooms AS NumRooms,
    ROUND(gt.grand_total_area) AS Area,
    -- grand total percent is 100% (or 0 if no area)
    CASE WHEN gt.grand_total_area = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100 END AS PctOfBuildArea,
    NULL AS BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL AS _sort_floor,
    NULL AS _sort_room,
    4 AS sort_order
  FROM grand_total gt
)
SELECT
  RowType,
  BuildingName,
  FloorNumber,
  RoomNumber,
  OwnershipType,
  OrganizationName,
  -- format numbers with commas; ensure integer rounding already applied above
  FORMAT(NumRooms,0) AS NumRooms,
  FORMAT(Area,0) AS Area,
  CONCAT(FORMAT(PctOfBuildArea,2), '%') AS PctOfBuildingArea
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM detail_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM floor_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM building_subtotals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM grand_total_row
) AS all_rows
ORDER BY
  -- Put GRAND TOTAL last via sort_order; otherwise by building name asc
  CASE WHEN BuildingName = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN CHAR(255) ELSE BuildingName END ASC,
  -- natural numeric-like ordering for floors where possible: try to cast to signed integer, fallback to string
  CASE
    WHEN _sort_floor REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN LPAD(CONVERT(_sort_floor, UNSIGNED), 10, '0')
    WHEN _sort_floor IS NULL THEN '~~~~~~~~~~' -- keep NULLs after numeric floors
    ELSE _sort_floor
  END ASC,
  sort_order ASC,
  -- within detail rows sort by room
  COALESCE(_sort_room, '') ASC

rows.question: For each financial aid year and academic year, list the number of fiscal periods, quarters, the start term date, the end term date, and number of distinct department-level term parameters.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH term_parameters_department_level AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_PARAMETER`
  FROM academic_term_parameter
  WHERE `TERM_PARAMETER` IS NOT NULL
    AND `TERM_PARAMETER` <> ''
),
terms_core AS (
  SELECT
    at.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY,
    at.TERM_CODE,
    at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.TERM_START_DATE,
    at.TERM_END_DATE
  FROM academic_terms AS at
  WHERE at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR IS NOT NULL
    AND at.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR <> ''
    AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
    AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR <> ''
)
SELECT
  tc.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR AS FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tc.TERM_CODE) AS NUM_FISCAL_PERIODS,
  -- Derive quarter code from TERM_START_DATE (assumes TERM_START_DATE in 'YYYY-MM-DD' or comparable ISO-like)
  COUNT(DISTINCT
    CASE
      WHEN tc.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL OR tc.TERM_START_DATE = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CONCAT(
        SUBSTRING(tc.TERM_START_DATE,1,4),
        '-Q',
        FLOOR((CAST(SUBSTRING(tc.TERM_START_DATE,6,2) AS UNSIGNED)+2)/3)
      )
    END
  ) AS NUM_QUARTERS,
  MIN(tc.TERM_START_DATE) AS TERM_START_DATE_MIN,
  MAX(tc.TERM_END_DATE) AS TERM_END_DATE_MAX,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tpd.TERM_PARAMETER) AS NUM_DISTINCT_DEPARTMENT_TERM_PARAMETERS
FROM terms_core tc
LEFT JOIN term_parameters_department_level tpd
  ON tpd.TERM_CODE = tc.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY
  tc.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR,
  tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR
ORDER BY
  tc.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ASC,
  tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ASC

rows.question: Group buildings by campus sectors. For each group, list the campus sector, name of the building, city and state where the building is located, total number of floors, total assignable area, total number of rooms, total number of organizations, ownership type, and a rank column indicating the order (1-indexed) of this row within each sector based on the descending order of assignable area. Include subtotals for each sector and a grand total across all sectors. The subtotal and grand total only need to computed over the total number of floors and assignable area.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_geography_and_ownership_join AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    b.BUILDING_MAILING_ADDRESS,
    COALESCE(CAST(b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS SIGNED), 0) AS BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    COALESCE(CAST(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS SIGNED), 0) AS BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    COALESCE(CAST(b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS SIGNED), 0) AS BUILDING_COUNTER,
    b.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    b.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM buildings b
),
rooms_per_building AS (
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms
  FROM fac_rooms
  WHERE BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
),
-- count distinct organizations by matching building's BUILDING_NUMBER to fclt_organization_hist.DLC_CODE if that's the intended link,
-- fallback: count distinct HR_ORG_UNIT_ID per DLC_KEY; try both by joining on building number = DLC_CODE
orgs_per_building AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(foh.DLC_KEY, NULL) AS dlc_key,
    COALESCE(foh.DLC_NAME, NULL) AS dlc_name,
    COALESCE(foh.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, NULL) AS hr_org_unit_id,
    foh.DLC_KEY,
    foh.DLC_NAME
  FROM fclt_organization_hist foh
  WHERE foh.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
orgs_count_by_dlc AS (
  SELECT DLC_KEY AS dlc_key, COUNT(DISTINCT HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS total_organizations
  FROM fclt_organization_hist
  WHERE HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DLC_KEY
),
-- bring building-level metrics together
buildings_with_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(bg.CAMPUS_SECTOR, 'UNASSIGNED') AS campus_sector,
    bg.BUILDING_KEY,
    bg.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    bg.BUILDING_NAME,
    ba.CITY AS city,
    ba.STATE AS state,
    COALESCE(bg.BUILDING_COUNTER, 0) AS total_floors,
    COALESCE(bg.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS total_assignable_area_sqft,
    COALESCE(rp.total_rooms, 0) AS total_rooms,
    COALESCE(ob.total_organizations, 0) AS total_organizations,
    COALESCE(bg.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, 'UNKNOWN') AS ownership_type
  FROM buildings_geography_and_ownership_join bg
  LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address ba ON ba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bg.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN rooms_per_building rp ON rp.BUILDING_KEY = bg.BUILDING_KEY
  -- join organizations by matching building number to DLC_CODE, and fallback to no match (0)
  LEFT JOIN orgs_count_by_dlc ob ON ob.dlc_key = bg.BUILDING_NUMBER
)
-- final select: building rows with rank, then subtotals per sector, then grand total
SELECT
  campus_sector,
  BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  city,
  state,
  total_floors,
  total_assignable_area_sqft,
  total_rooms,
  total_organizations,
  ownership_type,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY campus_sector
    ORDER BY total_assignable_area_sqft DESC
  ) AS rank_in_sector
FROM buildings_with_metrics

UNION ALL

SELECT
  campus_sector,
  'SUBTOTAL' AS building_name,
  NULL AS city,
  NULL AS state,
  SUM(total_floors) AS total_floors,
  SUM(total_assignable_area_sqft) AS total_assignable_area_sqft,
  NULL AS total_rooms,
  NULL AS total_organizations,
  NULL AS ownership_type,
  NULL AS rank_in_sector
FROM buildings_with_metrics
GROUP BY campus_sector

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'ALL SECTORS' AS campus_sector,
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS building_name,
  NULL AS city,
  NULL AS state,
  SUM(total_floors) AS total_floors,
  SUM(total_assignable_area_sqft) AS total_assignable_area_sqft,
  NULL AS total_rooms,
  NULL AS total_organizations,
  NULL AS ownership_type,
  NULL AS rank_in_sector
FROM buildings_with_metrics

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN campus_sector = 'ALL SECTORS' THEN 'ZZZ_GRAND_TOTAL' ELSE campus_sector END,
  -- ensure building rows (have non-null rank) come before subtotal/grand total
  CASE WHEN rank_in_sector IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  rank_in_sector

rows.question: For each department, list the name of the department, the title of the TIP material associated with the department, author, ISBN, library term code, and whether it is available in the library reserves ('Available in Library' if yes and 'Not Available in Library' otherwise), the total number of instructors per library book for the department, the total number of materials available in the library for the department, and the total number of available materials across all departments.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
td_min AS (
  -- pick a canonical term and subject for each tip material (to join to catalogs)
  SELECT
    TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    MIN(TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    MIN(SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID
  FROM tip_detail
  GROUP BY TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
-- determine which TIP materials are linked to library reserves (availability)
tip_has_reserve AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  FROM tip_detail d
  JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail l
    ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
    OR d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
    OR (d.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE)
),
-- map subject -> department using course_catalog_subject_offered (primary source)
subject_dept AS (
  SELECT
    SUBJECT_ID,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
-- count distinct instructors per (department_name, tip_material_key)
instructors_per_material_dept AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') AS department_name,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(dcc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, '')) AS num_instructors
  FROM td_min td
  LEFT JOIN subject_dept sd ON sd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
  -- use drupal_course_catalog as a source of responsible faculty per term/department
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dcc
    ON dcc.SO_TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
    AND (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL OR dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME)
  GROUP BY COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
),
-- total distinct TIP materials available in library per department
dept_totals AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') AS department_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_library_materials_for_department
  FROM td_min td
  LEFT JOIN subject_dept sd ON sd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
  WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IN (SELECT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY FROM tip_has_reserve)
  GROUP BY COALESCE(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '')
),
-- overall total distinct TIP materials available in library across all departments
all_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_library_available_materials_across_all_departments
  FROM tip_has_reserve
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  tm.TITLE AS TIP_TITLE,
  tm.AUTHOR AS TIP_AUTHOR,
  tm.ISBN AS TIP_ISBN,
  td.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE,
  CASE
    WHEN th.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NOT NULL THEN 'Available in Library'
    ELSE 'Not Available in Library'
  END AS LIBRARY_AVAILABILITY,
  COALESCE(ipmd.num_instructors, 0) AS TOTAL_INSTRUCTORS_PER_LIBRARY_BOOK,
  COALESCE(dt.total_library_materials_for_department, 0) AS TOTAL_MATERIALS_IN_LIBRARY_PER_DEPARTMENT,
  COALESCE(at.total_library_available_materials_across_all_departments, 0) AS TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MATERIALS_ALL_DEPARTMENTS
FROM tip_material tm
LEFT JOIN td_min td ON tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN subject_dept cd ON cd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID
-- fallback department source if course_catalog_subject_offered lacks mapping
LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog cis ON cis.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND (cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL OR cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = '')
LEFT JOIN (SELECT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY FROM tip_has_reserve) th ON th.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
LEFT JOIN instructors_per_material_dept ipmd
  ON ipmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
  AND ipmd.department_name = COALESCE(cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '')
LEFT JOIN dept_totals dt
  ON dt.department_name = COALESCE(cd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '')
CROSS JOIN all_total at
-- only consider TIP materials (have TIP fields present)
WHERE (tm.TITLE IS NOT NULL OR tm.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL OR tm.ISBN IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME

rows.question: For each building that is not a subdivision, list the building number, full name, street address, building type, occupancy date, ownership type, and site location. You should also include three rows at the end showing the number of owned, leased, all buildings at MIT that are not subdivisions, in the format of (null, #building Buildings, null, null, null, null, null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_core_165 AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    `BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
    `BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS` AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
    `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM `buildings`
)
SELECT
  bc.BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, bc.BUILDING_NAME) AS full_name,
  -- build a street address string from fac_building_address components
  TRIM(
    CONCAT(
      COALESCE(NULLIF(fba.STREET_NUMBER, ''), ''),
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NAME <> '' THEN CONCAT(CASE WHEN fba.STREET_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_NUMBER <> '' THEN ' ' ELSE '' END, fba.STREET_NAME) ELSE '' END,
      CASE WHEN fba.STREET_SUFFIX IS NOT NULL AND fba.STREET_SUFFIX <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STREET_SUFFIX) ELSE '' END,
      CASE
        WHEN (fba.POSTAL_CODE IS NOT NULL AND fba.POSTAL_CODE <> '') THEN CONCAT(', ', COALESCE(fba.CITY, ''), ' ', COALESCE(fba.STATE, ''), ' ', fba.POSTAL_CODE)
        WHEN (fba.CITY IS NOT NULL AND fba.CITY <> '') OR (fba.STATE IS NOT NULL AND fba.STATE <> '') THEN CONCAT(', ', COALESCE(fba.CITY, ''), CASE WHEN fba.STATE IS NOT NULL AND fba.STATE <> '' THEN CONCAT(' ', fba.STATE) ELSE '' END)
        ELSE ''
      END
    )
  ) AS street_address,
  fb.BUILDING_TYPE AS building_type,
  fb.DATE_OCCUPIED AS occupancy_date,
  fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS ownership_type,
  fb.SITE AS site_location
FROM buildings_core_165 bc
JOIN fac_building fb
  ON bc.BUILDING_NUMBER = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, STREET_NUMBER, STREET_NAME, STREET_SUFFIX, CITY, STATE, POSTAL_CODE, ADDRESS_PURPOSE
  FROM fac_building_address
  WHERE ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
) fba
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY OR bc.BUILDING_KEY = fba.BUILDING_KEY
WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT'
  AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE IN ('OWNED','LEASED')
  -- heuristic to exclude subdivisions: name not containing 'SUBDIVISION' and number not containing '-'
  AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME NOT LIKE '%SUBDIVISION%' AND bc.BUILDING_NUMBER NOT LIKE '%-%')

UNION ALL

SELECT
  NULL AS building_number,
  CONCAT(COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' THEN 1 END), ' Buildings') AS full_name,
  NULL AS street_address,
  NULL AS building_type,
  NULL AS occupancy_date,
  NULL AS ownership_type,
  NULL AS site_location
FROM buildings_core_165 bc
JOIN fac_building fb
  ON bc.BUILDING_NUMBER = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT'
  AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE IN ('OWNED','LEASED')
  AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME NOT LIKE '%SUBDIVISION%' AND bc.BUILDING_NUMBER NOT LIKE '%-%')

UNION ALL

SELECT
  NULL AS building_number,
  CONCAT(COUNT(CASE WHEN fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'LEASED' THEN 1 END), ' Buildings') AS full_name,
  NULL AS street_address,
  NULL AS building_type,
  NULL AS occupancy_date,
  NULL AS ownership_type,
  NULL AS site_location
FROM buildings_core_165 bc
JOIN fac_building fb
  ON bc.BUILDING_NUMBER = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT'
  AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE IN ('OWNED','LEASED')
  AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME NOT LIKE '%SUBDIVISION%' AND bc.BUILDING_NUMBER NOT LIKE '%-%')

UNION ALL

SELECT
  NULL AS building_number,
  CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings') AS full_name,
  NULL AS street_address,
  NULL AS building_type,
  NULL AS occupancy_date,
  NULL AS ownership_type,
  NULL AS site_location
FROM buildings_core_165 bc
JOIN fac_building fb
  ON bc.BUILDING_NUMBER = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
WHERE fb.SITE = 'MIT'
  AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE IN ('OWNED','LEASED')
  AND (fb.BUILDING_NAME NOT LIKE '%SUBDIVISION%' AND bc.BUILDING_NUMBER NOT LIKE '%-%')
ORDER BY
  -- keep the totals at the end; put NULLs last by ordering building_number NULLS LAST emulation
  CASE WHEN building_number IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  building_number

rows.question: In ascending order of construction start year, for each owned building that is not a subdivision, list the construction start year, the building number, and the year of initial occupancy. Display the construction start year only if it differs from the previous row. If the year of initial occupancy or construction start year is unknown, display 'UNKNOWN'. You should also include a row at the end showing the total number of owned buildings that are not subdivisions, in the format of (null, #building Buildings, null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH buildings_owned_non_subdivision_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    f.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    f.DATE_BUILT AS DATE_BUILT,
    f.DATE_OCCUPIED AS DATE_OCCUPIED
  FROM `fclt_building` AS f
  WHERE f.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
    AND (f.BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR LOWER(f.BUILDING_NAME) NOT LIKE '%subdivision%')
    AND (f.PARENT_BUILDING_NAME IS NULL OR LOWER(f.PARENT_BUILDING_NAME) NOT LIKE '%subdivision%')
    AND (f.PARENT_BUILDING_NAME_LONG IS NULL OR LOWER(f.PARENT_BUILDING_NAME_LONG) NOT LIKE '%subdivision%')
),
parsed_and_sorted AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR TRIM(DATE_BUILT) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y')
    END AS construction_year_string,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR TRIM(DATE_BUILT) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_BUILT, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y') AS SIGNED)
    END AS construction_year_numeric,
    CASE
      WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED IS NULL OR TRIM(DATE_OCCUPIED) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(DATE_OCCUPIED, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%Y')
    END AS occupancy_year_string
  FROM buildings_owned_non_subdivision_cohort
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    construction_year_string,
    construction_year_numeric,
    occupancy_year_string,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY (construction_year_numeric IS NULL), construction_year_numeric, BUILDING_NUMBER
    ) AS rn
  FROM parsed_and_sorted
),
show_flags AS (
  SELECT
    n.*,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(n.construction_year_string) OVER (
             ORDER BY (n.construction_year_numeric IS NULL), n.construction_year_numeric, n.BUILDING_NUMBER
           ) IS NULL
           AND n.construction_year_string IS NOT NULL THEN 1
      WHEN LAG(n.construction_year_string) OVER (
             ORDER BY (n.construction_year_numeric IS NULL), n.construction_year_numeric, n.BUILDING_NUMBER
           ) <> n.construction_year_string THEN 1
      WHEN LAG(n.construction_year_string) OVER (
             ORDER BY (n.construction_year_numeric IS NULL), n.construction_year_numeric, n.BUILDING_NUMBER
           ) IS NULL
           AND n.construction_year_string IS NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS show_construction_year_flag
  FROM numbered n
),
ordered_results AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN show_construction_year_flag = 1 THEN COALESCE(construction_year_string, 'UNKNOWN')
      ELSE NULL
    END AS construction_start_year,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
    COALESCE(occupancy_year_string, 'UNKNOWN') AS initial_occupancy_year,
    construction_year_numeric,
    BUILDING_NUMBER AS ord_building_number,
    rn
  FROM show_flags
)
SELECT construction_start_year, building_number, initial_occupancy_year
FROM ordered_results
UNION ALL
SELECT
  NULL AS construction_start_year,
  CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings') AS building_number,
  NULL AS initial_occupancy_year
FROM buildings_owned_non_subdivision_cohort
ORDER BY (construction_start_year IS NULL), -- show grouped years first (non-null)
         CAST(construction_start_year AS SIGNED), -- numeric year ordering (UNKNOWN -> CAST NULL)
         building_number

rows.question: Group all buildings at MIT into either owned or leased. For each group, state the ownership type, usage type, number of buildings, gross square footage, number of rooms, and the number of associated organizations. Display the ownership type only if it differs from the previous row. Include subtotals for each group and a grand total across all groups. The subtotal and grand total rows should not include ownership type and usage type. Footage should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH base_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE AS OWNERSHIP,
    b.BUILDING_USE,
    b.SITE,
    b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER
  FROM buildings b
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    AND b.SITE = 'MIT'
    -- exclude subordinate components (only keep top-level building records)
    AND (b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR b.PARENT_BUILDING_NUMBER = '')
),
rooms_from_fac AS (
  SELECT
    fr.BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_orgs
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fr.BUILDING_KEY
),
rooms_from_fclt AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS num_orgs
  FROM fclt_rooms fr
  WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
rooms_orgs_agg AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(num_rooms) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(num_orgs) AS num_orgs
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM rooms_from_fac
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM rooms_from_fclt
  ) x
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
),
detail AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(b.OWNERSHIP,'Unknown') AS ownership_type,
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_USE,'') AS usage_type,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_buildings,
    SUM(COALESCE(b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,0)) AS gross_sq,
    SUM(COALESCE(ro.num_rooms,0)) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(COALESCE(ro.num_orgs,0)) AS number_of_organizations,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(b.OWNERSHIP,'Unknown') = 'Owned' THEN 1
      WHEN COALESCE(b.OWNERSHIP,'Unknown') = 'Leased' THEN 2
      ELSE 3
    END AS ownership_rank,
    COALESCE(b.OWNERSHIP,'Unknown') AS ownership_sort,
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_USE,'') AS usage_sort
  FROM base_buildings b
  LEFT JOIN rooms_orgs_agg ro ON ro.BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY b.OWNERSHIP, b.BUILDING_USE
),
subtotal AS (
  SELECT
    '' AS ownership_type,
    '' AS usage_type,
    SUM(number_of_buildings) AS number_of_buildings,
    SUM(gross_sq) AS gross_sq,
    SUM(number_of_rooms) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(number_of_organizations) AS number_of_organizations,
    1 AS row_group,
    MIN(ownership_rank) AS ownership_rank,
    ownership_sort
  FROM detail
  GROUP BY ownership_sort
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    '' AS ownership_type,
    '' AS usage_type,
    SUM(number_of_buildings) AS number_of_buildings,
    SUM(gross_sq) AS gross_sq,
    SUM(number_of_rooms) AS number_of_rooms,
    SUM(number_of_organizations) AS number_of_organizations,
    2 AS row_group,
    99 AS ownership_rank,
    NULL AS ownership_sort
  FROM detail
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN t.ownership_type = '' THEN NULL ELSE t.ownership_type END AS ownership_type,
  CASE WHEN t.usage_type = '' THEN NULL ELSE t.usage_type END AS usage_type,
  t.number_of_buildings,
  FORMAT(ROUND(t.gross_sq),0) AS gross_square_footage,
  t.number_of_rooms,
  t.number_of_organizations
FROM (
  SELECT
    d.ownership_type,
    d.usage_type,
    d.number_of_buildings,
    d.gross_sq,
    d.number_of_rooms,
    d.number_of_organizations,
    0 AS row_group,
    d.ownership_rank,
    d.ownership_sort,
    d.usage_sort
  FROM detail d

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    s.ownership_type,
    s.usage_type,
    s.number_of_buildings,
    s.gross_sq,
    s.number_of_rooms,
    s.number_of_organizations,
    s.row_group,
    s.ownership_rank,
    s.ownership_sort,
    NULL AS usage_sort
  FROM subtotal s

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    g.ownership_type,
    g.usage_type,
    g.number_of_buildings,
    g.gross_sq,
    g.number_of_rooms,
    g.number_of_organizations,
    g.row_group,
    g.ownership_rank,
    g.ownership_sort,
    NULL AS usage_sort
  FROM grand_total g
) t

rows.question: For each building use, list the type, the number of distinct buildings (excluding subdivisions) of this use, the total gross square footage of these buildings, and the number of unique organizations associated with the rooms in these buildings. If the building is used as a residence, display the usage type as "RESIDENTIAL." You should also include a row at the end showing the total number of buildings, the gross square footage, and the number of organizations across all types of building use. All numerical values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH src_buildings AS (
  -- unify buildings from buildings and fac_building, one row per BUILDING_NUMBER
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    NULL AS fac_building_key,
    b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS gross_sqft,
    NULL AS ext_gross_area,
    NULL AS building_use
  FROM buildings b
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    AND b.BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    NULL AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS fac_building_key,
    NULL AS gross_sqft,
    fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS ext_gross_area,
    fb.BUILDING_USE
  FROM fac_building fb
  WHERE fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    AND fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA IS NOT NULL
),

distinct_buildings AS (
  -- deduplicate by BUILDING_NUMBER, prefer non-null BUILDING_USE and take max available gross area
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    MAX(BUILDING_NAME) AS BUILDING_NAME,
    MAX(building_use) AS BUILDING_USE,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(MAX(gross_sqft), 0),
      COALESCE(MAX(ext_gross_area), 0)
    ) AS gross_sqft
  FROM src_buildings
  GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER
),

building_orgs AS (
  -- map rooms to building numbers and collect distinct org ids per building
  SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(bld.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    org.org_id
  FROM (
    -- unify room organization sources; use organization identifier columns present in room tables
    SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS org_id
    FROM fclt_rooms
    WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY, ORGANIZATION_KEY AS org_id
    FROM fac_rooms
    WHERE ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS org_id
    FROM fclt_rooms_hist
    WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY IS NOT NULL
  ) org
  LEFT JOIN buildings bld ON bld.BUILDING_KEY = org.BUILDING_KEY
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = org.BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE COALESCE(bld.BUILDING_NUMBER, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER) IS NOT NULL
),

per_building AS (
  -- combine distinct_buildings with counted distinct organizations per building
  SELECT
    d.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(d.BUILDING_USE, '') AS BUILDING_USE,
    d.gross_sqft,
    COALESCE(borg.num_orgs, 0) AS num_orgs
  FROM distinct_buildings d
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT org_id) AS num_orgs
    FROM building_orgs
    GROUP BY BUILDING_NUMBER
  ) borg ON borg.BUILDING_NUMBER = d.BUILDING_NUMBER
),

labeled AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN pb.BUILDING_USE = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
      WHEN pb.BUILDING_USE = 'RESIDENT' THEN 'RESIDENTIAL'
      ELSE pb.BUILDING_USE
    END AS USAGE_TYPE,
    ROUND(pb.gross_sqft) AS gross_sqft_int,
    pb.num_orgs
  FROM per_building pb
)

SELECT
  USAGE_TYPE,
  FORMAT(COUNT(*) ,0) AS BUILDING_COUNT,
  FORMAT(SUM(gross_sqft_int) ,0) AS TOTAL_GROSS_SQFT,
  FORMAT(SUM(num_orgs) ,0) AS ORGANIZATION_COUNT
FROM labeled
GROUP BY USAGE_TYPE

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Total' AS USAGE_TYPE,
  FORMAT(COUNT(*) ,0) AS BUILDING_COUNT,
  FORMAT(SUM(gross_sqft_int) ,0) AS TOTAL_GROSS_SQFT,
  FORMAT(SUM(num_orgs) ,0) AS ORGANIZATION_COUNT
FROM labeled

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN USAGE_TYPE = 'Total' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END,
  USAGE_TYPE

rows.question: For each organization except Cambridge-MIT Institute, list its ID, number, level, formatted name according to level (if level is 2, there should be 1 space before the name, if level is 3, there should be 2 space before the name, up to level 6), whether it is assignable ('ASSIGNABLE' if assignable, 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' otherwise), total area, number of rooms, and average room area. Area and number of rooms should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER AS ORGANIZATION_NUMBER,
  CAST(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS SIGNED) AS ORGANIZATION_LEVEL,
  CONCAT(
    REPEAT(' ', GREATEST(0, LEAST(5, CAST(fo.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL AS SIGNED) - 1))),
    fo.ORGANIZATION
  ) AS FORMATTED_ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  CASE WHEN fo.ASSIGNABLE = '1' THEN 'ASSIGNABLE' ELSE 'NON-ASSIGNABLE' END AS ASSIGNABLE_FLAG,
  FORMAT(ROUND(fr.total_area),0) AS TOTAL_AREA,
  FORMAT(ROUND(fr.room_count),0) AS NUMBER_OF_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(ROUND(fr.total_area / fr.room_count),0) AS AVERAGE_ROOM_AREA
FROM fclt_organization fo
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    SUM(IFNULL(AREA,0)) AS total_area,
    SUM(IF(AREA IS NULL,0,1)) AS room_count -- count rooms contributing area; preserves non-null AREA rows
  FROM fclt_rooms
  GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
) fr ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')
  AND fr.room_count IS NOT NULL
  AND fr.room_count <> 0
ORDER BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER

rows.question: List each building key and floor key within the department of facilities, the number of rooms, total area, average area per floor, building name, access level, zip code, and city. Include subtotals for each building and a grand total across all buildings. The subtotals and grand total should not include zip code or city. Numbers of rooms and area should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_organization_dim AS (
  SELECT
    `ORGANIZATION_KEY`,
    `ORGANIZATION_NAME`
  FROM `fac_organization`
  WHERE `ORGANIZATION_NAME` = 'DP OF FACILITIES'
),
-- per building+floor detail for the department
detail AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY        AS BUILDING_KEY,
    fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY           AS FLOOR_KEY,
    COUNT(*)                    AS num_rooms,
    COALESCE(SUM(fr.AREA),0)    AS total_area,
    -- average area per room on that floor
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(fr.AREA) / COUNT(*) END AS avg_area_per_room,
    MAX(fr.ACCESS_LEVEL)        AS access_level
  FROM `fclt_rooms` fr
  JOIN fac_organization_dim od
    ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = od.ORGANIZATION_KEY
  GROUP BY fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
),
-- per building subtotal (summing floors)
building_subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    d.BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL                       AS FLOOR_KEY,
    SUM(d.num_rooms)           AS num_rooms,
    SUM(d.total_area)          AS total_area,
    -- average area per floor for the building: total_area / number_of_floors
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.FLOOR_KEY) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE SUM(d.total_area) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.FLOOR_KEY) END AS avg_area_per_room,
    MAX(d.access_level)        AS access_level
  FROM detail d
  GROUP BY d.BUILDING_KEY
),
-- grand total across all buildings
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    NULL                       AS BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL                       AS FLOOR_KEY,
    SUM(d.num_rooms)           AS num_rooms,
    SUM(d.total_area)          AS total_area,
    -- average area per floor across all buildings: total_area / number_of_floors_across_all_buildings
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.FLOOR_KEY) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE SUM(d.total_area) / COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(d.BUILDING_KEY,'|',d.FLOOR_KEY)) END AS avg_area_per_room,
    NULL                       AS access_level
  FROM detail d
),
-- building lookup with address (one address row per building; if multiple addresses exist, pick one by MIN BUILDING_ADDRESS_KEY)
building_info AS (
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    ba.POSTAL_CODE AS zip_code,
    ba.CITY        AS city
  FROM `buildings` b
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT BUILDING_KEY, POSTAL_CODE, CITY
    FROM `fac_building_address`
    -- if multiple addresses per building exist, pick arbitrary one using GROUP BY trick
    GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
  ) ba ON b.BUILDING_KEY = ba.BUILDING_KEY
)
-- union detail rows, building subtotals, and grand total
SELECT
  'detail'                             AS ROW_TYPE,
  d.BUILDING_KEY                       AS BUILDING_KEY,
  d.FLOOR_KEY                          AS FLOOR_KEY,
  FORMAT(ROUND(d.num_rooms),0)         AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(ROUND(d.total_area),0)        AS TOTAL_AREA,
  FORMAT(ROUND(d.avg_area_per_room),0) AS AVG_AREA_PER_ROOM,
  bi.BUILDING_NAME                     AS BUILDING_NAME,
  d.access_level                       AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
  bi.zip_code                          AS ZIP_CODE,
  bi.city                              AS CITY,
  -- ordering columns for final sort
  bi.BUILDING_NAME                     AS __order_building_name,
  1                                    AS __order_group,
  d.FLOOR_KEY                          AS __order_floor
FROM detail d
LEFT JOIN building_info bi ON d.BUILDING_KEY = bi.BUILDING_KEY

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'building_subtotal'                  AS ROW_TYPE,
  bs.BUILDING_KEY                      AS BUILDING_KEY,
  NULL                                 AS FLOOR_KEY,
  FORMAT(ROUND(bs.num_rooms),0)        AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(ROUND(bs.total_area),0)       AS TOTAL_AREA,
  FORMAT(ROUND(bs.avg_area_per_room),0)AS AVG_AREA_PER_ROOM,
  bi.BUILDING_NAME                     AS BUILDING_NAME,
  bs.access_level                      AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
  NULL                                 AS ZIP_CODE,
  NULL                                 AS CITY,
  bi.BUILDING_NAME                     AS __order_building_name,
  2                                    AS __order_group,
  NULL                                 AS __order_floor
FROM building_subtotals bs
LEFT JOIN building_info bi ON bs.BUILDING_KEY = bi.BUILDING_KEY

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'grand_total'                        AS ROW_TYPE,
  NULL                                 AS BUILDING_KEY,
  NULL                                 AS FLOOR_KEY,
  FORMAT(ROUND(gt.num_rooms),0)        AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(ROUND(gt.total_area),0)       AS TOTAL_AREA,
  FORMAT(ROUND(gt.avg_area_per_room),0)AS AVG_AREA_PER_ROOM,
  NULL                                 AS BUILDING_NAME,
  NULL                                 AS ACCESS_LEVEL,
  NULL                                 AS ZIP_CODE,
  NULL                                 AS CITY,
  NULL                                 AS __order_building_name,
  3                                    AS __order_group,
  NULL                                 AS __order_floor
FROM grand_total gt

ORDER BY
  -- Order by building name (NULLs last), then detail (1) then subtotal (2) then grand total (3),
  -- then by floor for detail rows
  CASE WHEN __order_building_name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  __order_building_name,
  __order_group,
  __order_floor

rows.question: For each IAP category, list its name, number of unique sessions, total number of attendees, active period (in the format of 'beginning term code-end term code'), the most common sponsor name, and the most common session start time. Include a grand total row showing the total number of sessions and attendees across all categories in the format of ('TOTAL', number of sessions, number of attendees, null, null, null).
rows.pred_sql:
WITH iap_subject_category_dim AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`,
    `IAP_CATEGORY_NAME` AS CATEGORY_NAME
  FROM `iap_subject_category`
),
iap_sessions_row_level_176 AS (
  SELECT
    `SECTION_ID`,
    `SO_TERM_CODE`,
    `SO_SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SO_CLUSTER_TYPE`,
    `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
    `MEET_TIME`,
    `MEET_PLACE`,
    `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `drupal_course_catalog`
),
iap_subject_detail_link AS (
  SELECT
    d.`IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`,
    d.`IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY`,
    d.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    d.`IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY`,
    d.`ENROLLMENT_TYPE`,
    d.`ATTENDANCE`,
    d.`TERM_CODE`,
    d.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `iap_subject_detail` d
),
iap_session_combined AS (
  SELECT
    c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    c.CATEGORY_NAME,
    ses.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    ses.SESSION_LOCATION,
    dr.SECTION_ID,
    dr.SO_TERM_CODE,
    dr.SO_SUBJECT_ID,
    dr.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
    dr.MEET_TIME,
    -- normalize attendance to integer (if blank/null treat as 0)
    CASE
      WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(d.ATTENDANCE, '')) = '' THEN 0
      ELSE CAST(d.ATTENDANCE AS SIGNED)
    END AS ATTENDANCE,
    d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
  FROM iap_subject_category_dim c
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_detail_link d
    ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  LEFT JOIN `iap_subject_session` ses
    ON ses.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  LEFT JOIN iap_sessions_row_level_176 dr
    ON dr.SO_SUBJECT_ID = ses.SESSION_LOCATION
    OR dr.SECTION_ID = ses.SESSION_LOCATION
    OR dr.SO_SUBJECT_ID = d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
)
SELECT
  t.category_name AS CATEGORY_NAME,
  t.unique_sessions AS NUM_UNIQUE_SESSIONS,
  t.total_attendees AS TOTAL_ATTENDEES,
  t.active_period AS ACTIVE_PERIOD,
  t.most_common_sponsor AS MOST_COMMON_SPONSOR,
  t.most_common_session_start_time AS MOST_COMMON_START_TIME
FROM (
  -- category-level rows
  SELECT
    isc.CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(isc.SECTION_ID, isc.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY, isc.SESSION_LOCATION)) AS unique_sessions,
    COALESCE(SUM(isc.ATTENDANCE), 0) AS total_attendees,
    CASE
      WHEN MIN(isc.SO_TERM_CODE) IS NULL AND MAX(isc.SO_TERM_CODE) IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(MIN(isc.SO_TERM_CODE), ''), '-', COALESCE(MAX(isc.SO_TERM_CODE), ''))
    END AS active_period,
    (
      SELECT s2.SPONSOR_NAME
      FROM iap_subject_detail d2
      JOIN iap_subject_sponsor s2
        ON d2.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s2.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
      WHERE d2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
      GROUP BY s2.SPONSOR_NAME
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS most_common_sponsor,
    (
      SELECT rs.MEET_TIME
      FROM iap_session_combined rs
      WHERE rs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
        AND rs.MEET_TIME IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(rs.MEET_TIME) <> ''
      GROUP BY rs.MEET_TIME
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS most_common_session_start_time,
    isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  FROM iap_session_combined isc
  WHERE isc.CATEGORY_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY isc.CATEGORY_NAME, isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY

  UNION ALL

  -- grand total row
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(SECTION_ID, IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY, SESSION_LOCATION)) AS unique_sessions,
    COALESCE(SUM(ATTENDANCE), 0) AS total_attendees,
    NULL AS active_period,
    NULL AS most_common_sponsor,
    NULL AS most_common_session_start_time,
    NULL AS IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
  FROM iap_session_combined
) t
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN t.category_name = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
